title: Apply for a seniors discount on National Parks annual passes
summary: Seniors Card holders can apply online to receive a discount on NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service annual passes.
intro:
Seniors Card holders can apply online for a discount on all NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service annual passes. This can be for any vehicle registered in their name or at their home address.

The discount provides seniors with a saving of approximately 20% on the full price of the pass.

The 4 types of annual passes are:

Annual passes are digital, which means you will not receive a physical pass to display in your vehicle.

You can buy 1-year and 2-year passes online.

If you're a concession card holder, you may be eligible for a concession pass.
who_can_apply: Must be a Seniors Card holder.
The pass can be for any vehicle registered in the applicant's name or at their home address.
what_you_need: A copy of both sides of your Seniors Card
A copy of your vehicle certificate of registration paper

how_to_steps.text: Select the annual pass you want to buy.
Select 'I'm an Australian Seniors Card holder'.
Read and accept the terms and conditions.

more_info.text: The discount does not apply to single or multi-day passes.
Seniors discounts cannot be combined with any other annual pass discounts.
Your pass provides entry for the vehicle that is linked to your digital pass. You're not able to transfer passes between vehicles.
